coverage_override.reason: The continuous ATK modifier and the once-per-turn cost/summon/search Ignition Effect are two effects; the activation oath belongs to the Field Spell activation.

effects.printed_clause: All opponent monsters lose 500 ATK for each Vir Pedicae Mortis monster you control.
effects.lua_implementation: A field EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK targets the opponent's Monster Zone and dynamically returns -500 times the current number of face-up controlled Vir Pedicae Mortis monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: A continuous Field Spell recalculates a live value from the controller's current monster state.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, banish 1 card from your GY, then discard 1; Special Summon Pedicae's Papa or a Vir Pedicae Mortis monster from the Deck, then add Recollection: Kaboom Papa. Only 1 Mine activation per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Ignition Effect pays the ordered banish and discard costs, Special Summons exact Pedicae's Papa or an archetype Monster from the Deck, and only after a successful summon adds exact Kaboom Papa. The activation effect has an oath limit and the Ignition Effect has its own soft once-per-turn limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses sequential GY/hand costs followed by a filtered Special Summon operation.

effects.issue: Fixed the source card text typo from Predicae's Papa to the actual card name Pedicae's Papa; the existing exact-code Lua was correct.
